> Before filing: this repo is built primarily for one person's use (see [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md) on scope). Changes that don't fit the maintainer's environment may be declined. For non-trivial work, open the issue first and check the idea fits before writing code.

## The problem

What are you trying to do, and what's getting in the way? Describe the underlying problem — not the proposed solution.

## What you've tried

Existing tools, scripts, or workarounds. If something nearly works but falls short, that's useful context.

## Proposed change

What you think the repo should do differently. Specific is better than abstract. If you can sketch the script signature, Terraform resource, or doc section, even better.

## Alternatives

Other ways the problem could be solved. If you considered them and ruled them out, explain why.

## Fit with the repo

A quick sanity check against the [README principles](../../README.md#about):

- Short scripts you can read in one sitting, not frameworks.
- Lean on vendor APIs and existing tools rather than reinvent them.
- Keep a human in the loop where automation can plausibly get things wrong.

If your idea fights any of these, say how — there might still be a path forward.
